channel.description: Theo is a software dev, AI nerd, TypeScript sympathizer, creator of T3 Chat and the T3 Stack.

title: TOON: “JSON for AI” (is it any good?)
description:
JSON is great, but it also uses a ton of tokens during llm generations. What if there was something better?

Thank you G2i for sponsoring! Check them out at: https://soydev.link/g2i

SOURCE
https://github.com/toon-format/toon#readme

Want to sponsor a video? Learn more here: https://soydev.link/sponsor-me

Check out my Twitch, Twitter, Discord more at https://t3.gg

S/O Ph4se0n3 for the awesome edit 🙏
